## Where the product stands

The free core is feature complete and now, for the first time, honest end to end. It measures real usage from local transcripts, advises, reduces behind a backup and diff and confirm gate, and proves results with labelled experiments that will publish an honest NOT_PROVEN.

Fleet is complete through F3: an organisation installs across every machine with one line onto a private git store with no server, and reads an org-wide page that turns any broken or hostile record into its own named NO DATA row rather than an outage. A stranger can try the whole product with one command and install nothing.

Version 1.8.0 is released and installed here. The MCP server is registered and connected.

## What changed today that matters most

The proof engine could not do its job, and now it can. Three separate defects had to be fixed for that sentence to be true.

First, a VERIFIED verdict was structurally unreachable. The config fingerprint hashed the raw bytes of ~/.claude.json, which Claude Code rewrites several times a minute, so the downgrade reason "config changed during experiment window" fired on every experiment forever. This is also one of the three reasons claude-md-diet v1 closed NOT_PROVEN, where at the time it read as an unlucky window rather than a defect.

Second, had a verdict been reachable, it could have been manufactured by parse failures. The cohort reader dropped unreadable files and undecodable lines without counting them, and a dropped first line promotes a cheap mid-conversation turn to "first request", which is the exact number the verdict compares.

Third, once published, a claim never expired. All three latest-wins readers filtered by confidence before picking the latest row, so a re-run that failed to reproduce a result did not supersede it. The share card, the artifact designed to leave the machine, kept printing "proven".

## The release boundary, unchanged

No version tag, no release, no plugin publish, and no local plugin update or MCP re-registration on this machine until claude-md-diet-v2 reaches its verdict near 2026-09-13. Building is authorized. Releasing is not. Tagging and publishing to the world is fine when the verdict lands; installing the result here is what would corrupt the experiment.

## Standing founder decisions

Fleet keeps its name. Signals holds at S2: client ready, nothing deployed, nothing sent, awaiting the consent layer and an endpoint decision. LAB1 stays parked until the verdict. Claude Code only supersedes the earlier Codex and Cursor roadmap line.

Handovers are delivered as ONE zip and never as loose files, by founder directive of today. That rule is merged into BrotherMode (PR 41) and reaches this machine at the next plugin update.
